On this sunny summer morning in St. Petersburg , [admiral Vladimir Korolev](http://warfare.be/0702ey70/common/korolev-bls.jpg) was standing on the newly improved and extended dockyards of the [United Shipbuilding Corporation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Shipbuilding_Corporation). The massive docks where still empty but a sight to behold none the less. Head of USC Andrei Dyachkov was nervously standing besides the admiral, work on the docks had taken 4 months longer then planned and he was uncertain how that would go down with military command.

"This looks.... adequate..." the admiral said while overlooking the site. Andrei sighed a breath of relief "I would like to show you the designs now comrade admiral" The men walked toward the office buildings where staff was anxiously setting up a presentation. The men entered the lobby and walked up to a big model of ["project Shtorm"](http://cdn4.img.sputniknews.com/images/102449/55/1024495560.jpg). The admiral slowly walked up to the model and started to inspect the little figures on the deck. The staff and Andrei held their breath nervously.... Korolev walked around the nuclear super carrier design and meticulously went over every centimeter. The staff was nervously looking at eachother and slowly dying of the silence... The admiral looked up and nodded to the head engineer. The nervous man stepped forward, swallowed and began his presentation on [Project 23000E also called project Shtorm.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0SaEO2H9Tps&feature=youtu.be) . The [Shtorm-class nuclear supercarriers](http://s017.radikal.ru/i422/1212/d7/ed6c92cd7f39.png) will have a capacity of 80-90 aircraft or helicopters and can carry a supplement of 2,500 Troops and their equipment. We are assured this design can rival the UK and USA supercarrier fleet and could be a viable export commodity to our closest allies. (India has shown interest IRL)

Upon hearing the presentation Admiral Vladimir Korolev grinned and seemed to get a twinkle in his eyes. He motioned the head of the USC to come near and he put his and on his shoulder "I have just seen the future of our navy. I will report favorably to our comrade Putin!" Andrei sighed with relief upon hearing these words. "Construction will begin as soon as possible comrade admiral. We have faith we can make the Russian navy proud of our new ships! Now could I interest you in [some lunch](https://img.thewhiskyexchange.com/540/vodka_rus1.jpg)?"
